summary.text: Daisy Berbeco is a Democratic state representative from Chittenden-21 who has served in the Vermont House of Representatives since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She has worked as a mental health professional and policy adviser.

paragraphs.text: Daisy Berbeco was born in Alaska and lives in Vermont.
She earned a B.S. in geology from Sonoma State University and an M.A. in science, society and development from the University of Sussex.

Her career experience includes working as a consultant, director and manager for nonprofits related to mental health; she was director of special projects for the National Council for Mental Wellbeing and a senior advisor for mental health policy for the state of Vermont.
Berbeco assumed office in the Vermont House on January 4, 2023, and advanced from the Democratic primary on August 11, 2026.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, she named mobility, connection and purpose as her three key campaign messages.
